result.title: Search-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation with Sibling Alignment for Generative Recommendation
result.summary: Generative recommendation retrieves items by autoregressively generating semantic IDs, typically via beam search. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enhances training supervision by transferring privileged self-teacher knowledge at student-generated states. However, beam-search retention depends on competition among prefixes: visited states differ in importance, and initially reliable decisions may approach the pruning boundary as training evolves. Moreover, conventional distribution matching couples target-token confidence with preferences among competing continuations, potentially weakening relational supervision when the self-teacher strongly favors the target. To address these challenges, we propose Search-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation (SA-OPSD), a framework that transfers privileged self-teacher knowledge to the states visited during the student's own beam search. Specifically, we introduce Evolving-Boundary Sampling, which prioritizes search-critical states by considering both current pruning-boundary proximity and initial-reference retention-margin decline under a controlled distillation budget. Furthermore, we develop Confidence-Decoupled Branch Distillation, which separates target-probability calibration from informative sibling relations to better preserve the teacher's preferences among competing branches. Experiments on Industrial, Office, and Instruments demonstrate strong performance for SA-OPSD.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SA-OPSD，在生成式推荐的 beam search 中向学生自访问状态迁移自教师知识，用「演化边界采样」优先蒸馏关键状态，并用「置信度解耦分支蒸馏」分离目标概率校准与同级分支偏好。
AI.relevance_reason: 非多模态任务，但其按剪枝边界与保留裕度挑选搜索关键状态的思路，可供核查 LVR 中轨迹采样与贡献分配；解耦同级分支关系或可启发 latent 状态偏好监督的设计。
